title: 1.11 Friends and People
unit_outcome: Understand and say short Spanish sentences about people, family members, and what they are doing.
goal: Name a friend, the husband, the wife, the son, the daughter, a person and people.
grammar_function: Él/Ella es el/la + person word; la persona (always feminine); a mixed group takes the masculine plural (sentados).
speaking_outcome: Say who people are and what they are doing.
